placeholder.body: This page is built in a later milestone.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: We'll email you a sign-in link. No passwords to remember.
login.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it on this device.
login.devOpenOutbox: Development: open the link in the dev outbox

loginFinish.confirmBody: The link was opened on another device or browser. Enter the email address you signed in with.

onboarding.comingSoon: This is where you'll set up your company soon: name, logo and colour.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.invalid-action-code: This link is invalid or has already been used. Ask for a new one.
auth.expired-action-code: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.network-request-failed: No connection. Check your network and try again.
auth.popup-blocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
auth.too-many-requests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

functions.permission-denied: You don't have permission to do this.
functions.failed-precondition: This can't be done right now.
functions.resource-exhausted: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
functions.not-found: What you're looking for no longer exists.
functions.invalid-argument: One of the fields isn't filled in correctly.
functions.unavailable: The service isn't responding. Try again in a moment.

dev.outboxIntro: Messages that would have been sent, and sign-in links from the Auth emulator. Refreshes every three seconds.
dev.emulatorsDown: Can't reach the emulators. Run npm run dev.

ui.dialogBody: The client is told that the decision has been withdrawn.
